title: Hardship and Protective Holds — Proof of Active Duty for Military Service Hold Status Reviews
content:
## Guidance

Under Hardship and Protective Holds, before each status review of a running Military Service Hold, Ridgeline asks the servicemember for current proof of active military duty, because the review continues the hold only while active duty is shown to continue.

## Conditions on the request

The status review proof request is not sent until every undecided Military Service Hold request of the servicemember carries its initial documentation request, so that one set of orders answers all of them.

Before the status review proof due date is worked out, the hold's end date on record must already lie beyond that review's due date.

The same two conditions, read as states of the records:

- While any undecided Military Service Hold request of the servicemember does not yet carry its initial documentation request, the status review proof request is not sent.
- While the hold's end date on record does not lie beyond the due date of the review the proof is for, the status review proof due date is not worked out.

## What the request states

The request states the days allowed for the status review proof: the calendar days from the day of the request to the proof's due date, a whole number.

## Tool card: `request_service_review_proof_12b8aafa`

**Capability.** Asks a servicemember for current proof of active military duty for an upcoming status review of a running Military Service Hold. One call records one documentation request for active-duty status proof in the hold history, dated today, with a due date the given number of calendar days after today. The hold itself is not changed. On success the request and its due date appear in the hold history.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `request_service_review_proof_12b8aafa` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `hold_id` | The hold reference number of the running Military Service Hold under review, read from the hardship hold lookup | Identifier |
| `due_in_days` | The number of calendar days from today to the due date of the proof (1 means tomorrow) | Whole integer of at least 1; no decimals, no empty value |

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text with `request_ref` (the reference of the recorded request), `hold_id`, `document_type` (always `active_duty_status_proof`), `due_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `sent_on` (YYYY-MM-DD, today) and `status`, always `requested` when the request is recorded.

**Input and receipt (hypothetical).** Called on 10 June with `due_in_days` of 41, the request is recorded with a `due_date` of 21 July.
